digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 37
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Pellam Flags adds scheduled rollouts
items.summary: Pellam Flags adds scheduled rollouts for feature flags. A rollout can raise exposure in steps and pause on an alert.
items.whyItMatters: Releases can ramp up without manual steps.

items.title: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling
items.summary: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling, which keeps slow and failed requests and drops the rest. Rules are written in a small policy file.

items.title: Ingleby Search adds query caching
items.summary: Ingleby Search adds query caching, which is on by default. Teams switch it off per index.
items.whyItMatters: Repeated queries can be served from the cache.

sources.title: Pellam Flags adds scheduled rollouts
sources.summary: Pellam Flags adds scheduled rollouts for feature flags. A rollout can raise exposure in steps and pause on an alert. Every change is recorded with the author and the time.

sources.title: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling
sources.summary: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling, which keeps slow and failed requests and drops the rest. Rules are written in a small policy file. Sampling decisions are written to an audit stream for later review.

sources.title: Ingleby Search adds query caching
sources.summary: Ingleby Search adds query caching, which is off by default. Teams switch it on per index. Cached results expire when the index changes.
